headline: Indian Wicketkeepers with 10,000+ ODI Runs
story: In the entire 53-year history of One Day International cricket, only one Indian wicketkeeper has ever crossed 10,000 ODI runs.
details: Dhoni amassed 10,773 ODI runs at an astonishing average of 50.57 and a strike rate of 87.56 — batting primarily in the middle and lower order at No. 5, 6, and 7.

headline: Captains to Win All Three ICC White-Ball Trophies
story: Only one captain in the 147-year history of international cricket has won the ICC T20 World Cup, ICC Cricket World Cup, and ICC Champions Trophy.
details:
1. 2007 ICC World Twenty20 (South Africa)
2. 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup (India)
3. 2013 ICC Champions Trophy (England). In addition, he led India to the ICC Test Championship Mace (Rank #1) in 2009.

headline: Indian Wicketkeepers with 150+ International Stumpings
stat_box: MS DHONI (195 STUMPINGS) — END OF LIST.
story: Dhoni holds the all-time world record for the most stumpings in international cricket history (195). No other Indian wicketkeeper has even reached 40.
details: His 195 stumpings (123 in ODIs, 38 in Tests, 34 in T20Is) lead 2nd-place Kumar Sangakkara (139) by 56 stumpings. He is the only keeper in ODI history with 100+ stumpings.

headline: Indian Wicketkeepers with a Test Double-Century
stat_box: MS DHONI (224 VS AUSTRALIA) — END OF LIST.
story: Only one Indian designated wicketkeeper in history has scored a double-century in Test cricket.
details: Dhoni smashed 224 off 265 balls with 24 fours and 6 sixes against Australia at Chepauk, Chennai in February 2013, setting up an 8-wicket victory and a 4-0 series sweep.

headline: Batters to Score Multiple ODI Centuries Batting at No. 7 or Lower
stat_box: MS DHONI (2 CENTURIES AT NO. 7) — END OF LIST.
story: In the entire history of ODI cricket, MS Dhoni is the only batsman to score more than one century batting from position No. 7 or lower.
details: 139* vs Africa XI (Chennai, 2007) & 113* vs Pakistan (Chennai, 2012 after India were reeling at 29/5).

headline: Indian Batters with 1,000+ ODI Runs vs Pakistan @ 50+ Average
stat_box: MS DHONI (1,230 RUNS @ 53.47 AVG) — END OF LIST.
story: Among all Indian batsmen in cricket history with 1,000+ ODI runs against arch-rivals Pakistan, MS Dhoni is the only one who averaged over 50.00.
details: In 36 matches against Pakistan, Dhoni scored 1,230 runs with 2 centuries and 9 fifties at a strike rate of 89.45 and an average of 53.47.

headline: 73 Years of Indian Test Wicketkeeping vs Dhoni Alone
stat_box: 4,876 Runs in 90 Tests vs 4,693 Runs in 163 Tests
story: Before Dhoni's Test debut in December 2005, ALL Indian wicketkeepers combined in history (1932–2005) had scored 4,693 runs in 163 Tests at a 24.91 average with 4 hundreds.
details: Dhoni then took only 90 Tests to score 4,876 runs at 38.09 average with 6 hundreds and 33 fifties — scoring more Test runs alone than the previous 73 years combined.

headline: India's Successful Run Chase Average
story: Before Dhoni's debut in 2004, India's win percentage in ODI run chases was 53.4%. When Dhoni batted in successful chases, his average soared to 102.71.
details: Across 84 innings in successful ODI run chases, Dhoni scored 2,876 runs with 47 not outs (56.0% not out rate), lifting India's chase win rate to an unprecedented 72.4%.

headline: Most ODI Runs Batting at Position No. 6 in World Cricket
story: MS Dhoni scored 4,164 runs batting at No. 6 alone — the all-time world record for most ODI runs from this lower-middle order position.
details: No other player in ODI history has crossed 4,000 runs at No. 6. He averaged 47.31 with a strike rate of 83.91, proving that a world-class finisher can also match top-order batting averages.

headline: Highest ODI Score by a Wicketkeeper in Cricket History
story: On October 31, 2005 in Jaipur, 24-year-old Dhoni smashed 183* chasing 299 against Sri Lanka.
details: It broke Adam Gilchrist's 172 to set the all-time world record for the highest individual ODI score by a designated wicketkeeper, as well as the highest individual score in a successful ODI chase by an Indian.
source: ICC Hall of Fame & Match Scorecards

headline: World-Record 0.08s Stumping Speed vs Human Eye Blink
story: During the 4th ODI vs West Indies in Mumbai in 2018, Dhoni stumped Keemo Paul off Ravindra Jadeja in just 0.08 seconds.
details: The average human eye blink takes between 100ms and 400ms (0.10s to 0.40s). Dhoni removed the bails in 80 milliseconds without pulling his hands backward.

headline: Most Dismissals in a Single ODI Match by an Indian
story: Against England at Headingley, Leeds in September 2007, Dhoni equaled the world record with 6 dismissals in a single ODI innings.
details: He took 5 catches and executed 1 stumping off Piyush Chawla, remaining the only Indian wicketkeeper to record 6 dismissals in an ODI.

headline: 1,001 Career Dismissals Across All Professional Cricket
story: Across Tests, ODIs, T20Is, IPL, and CLT20 (789 total matches), Dhoni effected 1,001 total wicketkeeping dismissals and run-outs.
details: International: 829 dismissals (634 catches, 195 stumpings). IPL & Franchise: 205 dismissals (158 catches, 47 stumpings).

headline: Most Matches as International Captain in Cricket History
story: MS Dhoni has captained his country in more international matches than any other captain in the history of world cricket (332 matches).
details: 60 Tests (27 wins), 200 ODIs (110 wins), and 72 T20Is (41 wins) — winning 178 international matches with a 53.6% win rate.

headline: Most Test Wins vs Australia as Captain in Cricket History
story: MS Dhoni is tied 3rd in world cricket history for the most Test match victories as a captain against Australia.
details: Dhoni led India to 8 wins in 13 Tests against Australia (61.5% win rate), including the famous 4-0 Border-Gavaskar whitewash in 2013.

headline: 10 IPL Finals in 14 Seasons with Chennai Super Kings
stat_box: 5 IPL Titles + 2 CLT20 Titles (7 Franchise Trophies)
story: Under MS Dhoni's captaincy, Chennai Super Kings qualified for 10 IPL Finals in 14 seasons played, winning 5 Championships.
details: He captained CSK in 226 IPL matches, winning 133 (59.3% win rate) — making him the most decorated franchise captain in cricket history.

headline: Fastest Player in History to Reach No. 1 in ODI Batting
stat_box: Reached ICC World No. 1 in Only 40th ODI
story: In April 2006, just 40 ODIs after his debut, MS Dhoni climbed to the No. 1 spot in the ICC ODI Batting Rankings.
details: He dethroned Ricky Ponting faster than any other player in cricket history, spending a cumulative 656 days at the top of the world rankings.
source: ICC Hall of Fame & ICC Rankings Retrospective

headline: Only Back-to-Back ICC ODI Player of the Year Winner
stat_box: ICC ODI Player of the Year (2008 & 2009)
story: MS Dhoni is the first player in history to win the prestigious ICC ODI Player of the Year award in consecutive years (2008 and 2009).
details: He was also named in the ICC ODI Team of the Year 8 times and selected as captain of the ICC ODI Team of the Decade (2011–2020).

headline: Destruction in IPL Death Overs (Overs 16–20)
story: In overs 16 to 20 of the IPL, Dhoni has faced 1,982 balls, scoring 3,468 runs with 208 sixes and 252 fours.
details: He holds the all-time IPL record for most sixes hit in the 20th over (over 65 sixes in the final over alone), maintaining a 23.2% boundary rate under maximum pressure.

headline: 16 Runs Off 4 Balls Heist vs Mumbai Indians (IPL 2022)
stat_box: 6, 4, 2, 4 in the Final Over at Age 40
story: Needing 16 runs off 4 balls against Jaydev Unadkat in IPL 2022 at DY Patil Stadium, 40-year-old Dhoni pulled off an impossible heist.
details: Ball 3: Monstrous 6 straight down the ground. Ball 4: 4 over short fine leg. Ball 5: Two to deep midwicket. Ball 6: 4 flicked past short fine leg off the final delivery to win!

headline: The 25-Meter Gloveless Sprint Run-Out (2016 T20 WC)
stat_box: Defended 2 Runs off 3 Balls vs Bangladesh
story: In the 2016 T20 World Cup thriller in Bengaluru, Bangladesh needed 2 runs off 3 balls. India took 3 wickets in 3 balls to win by 1 run.
details: Anticipating a bye on the final ball, Dhoni removed his right glove beforehand, gathered the missed edge, and outsprinted Mustafizur Rahman across 25 meters to shatter the stumps by centimeters.
source: ICC T20 World Cup 2016 Match Telemetry

headline: Record 100* 8th-Wicket Partnership with Bhuvneshwar Kumar
stat_box: From 131/7 to Victory vs Sri Lanka (Pallekele 2017)
story: Chasing 231 against Sri Lanka, India collapsed from 109/0 to 131/7 against Akila Dananjaya's mystery spin.
details: Dhoni (45*) partnered with No. 9 Bhuvneshwar Kumar (53*) to put on an unbeaten 100-run stand for the 8th wicket, steering India to victory with 16 balls to spare.

headline: The Impossible Triple Milestone
story: MS Dhoni is the only cricketer in history to achieve 17,000+ international runs as a batsman, 800+ international dismissals as a wicketkeeper, and win all 3 ICC white-ball trophies as captain.
details:
Tests: 4,876 runs + 284 dismissals + ICC Test Mace #1
ODIs: 10,773 runs + 426 dismissals + CWC 2011 & CT 2013
T20Is: 1,617 runs + 86 dismissals + T20 WC 2007
IPL: 5,243 runs + 205 dismissals + 5 IPL Championships.
source: ICC Hall of Fame Master Profile

headline: 84 Not-Outs in ODI Cricket History
story: MS Dhoni remained unbeaten in 84 out of 297 ODI innings, the most not-outs by any top/middle-order batsman in ODI history.
details: In matches where Dhoni remained not out, India won 47 out of 49 run-chases (95.9% win rate).

headline: Only Elite Wicketkeeper to Bowl in 9 Matches & Take an ICC Wicket
stat_box: Bowled in 9 International Matches (1 ICC Wicket)
story: Dhoni took off his wicketkeeping pads and bowled medium pace in 9 international matches (6 Tests, 2 ODIs, 1 T20I), bowling 132 deliveries.
details: He bowled West Indies opener Travis Dowlin clean at the Wanderers in the 2009 ICC Champions Trophy.
